checks.invariant: Staff JWT is a header secret; query-string access_token must not be an equivalent authentication door on SSE or upload routes.
checks.result: get_current_user_sse ORs optional HTTP Bearer with Query access_token and feeds the same user_from_access_token verifier. GET /jobs/{job_id}/events, POST /jobs/upload, and POST /jobs/{job_id}/upload-files all Depends(get_current_user_sse), so a JWT placed in the query is a full staff session on those routes.

checks.invariant: Browser EventSource must not put the staff JWT in the request URL.
checks.result: Dashboard constructs `${API_BASE}/jobs/${processingJobId}/events?access_token=${encodeURIComponent(token)}` and opens EventSource on that URL, placing the live JWT in the query.

checks.invariant: Secrets in URLs must not be copied into logs or third-party Referer.
checks.result: API process is uvicorn without --no-access-log (Procfile and Dockerfile.api). Uvicorn default access logs include the request target query. API Referrer-Policy is set only on API responses; Next.js next.config.mjs sets no document Referrer-Policy. Primary source-visible disclosure path is the authenticated request line to the API/proxy, not a third-party document Referer of the EventSource URL.

checks.invariant: Query JWT must still be HS256-verified with exp and DB principal bind.
checks.result: Query tokens take the same jwt.decode(secret_key, algorithms=[HS256], require_sub) path and User.id+account_id DB lookup as Authorization Bearer. No decode-without-verify branch. Alg is pinned; aud/iss are not bound.

checks.invariant: Anonymous GET /health may confirm liveness but must not disclose internal filesystem layout, catalog volume, or storage mode.
checks.result: health() has no Depends auth. It returns catalog_upload_root=str(upload_root()) (absolute backend/data/uploads), catalog_image_files_on_disk from an unauthenticated rglob of up to 200000 images, catalog_r2_configured, Gemini model names, and appraiser flags. Job folder paths are redacted in production via public_job_input_folder; health does not use that helper.

checks.invariant: Default OpenAPI /docs /redoc /openapi.json must be disabled or authenticated on the public API.
checks.result: app = FastAPI(title=settings.app_name) with no docs_url, redoc_url, or openapi_url override anywhere in the repo. FastAPI >=0.115 still serves /docs, /redoc, and /openapi.json anonymously, including schemas for admin, CT Seller, Facebook, and query access_token.

checks.invariant: /admin, /debug, /metrics, /env and FastAPI debug traces are not anonymous.
checks.result: No /debug /metrics /env routes. /admin/* uses get_current_user then _require_master_admin. FastAPI() is not constructed with debug=True. production_must_be_safe does not disable docs. Unhandled 500 traceback depends on Starlette debug default (false) and is not a source-proven disclosure.

checks.invariant: Anonymous callers cannot mint a new tenant owner JWT on a production estate-PII API after bootstrap.
checks.result: POST /auth/register is unauthenticated. The 403 gate is only settings.is_production and not settings.allow_open_registration. allow_open_registration defaults True (config and .env.example). DEPLOY.md says set false after the first account. On success the handler creates Account+owner User+General sale and returns create_access_token. The login page always offers Register.

checks.invariant: MASTER_ADMIN_EMAILS cannot be claimed by unauthenticated register.
checks.result: register does not compare payload.email to master_admin_email_list. is_master_admin_email is a casefolded env allowlist on the User.email of any authenticated principal. _require_master_admin is only that email check. A new User whose email is in MASTER_ADMIN_EMAILS and not yet in users can call /admin/accounts and other master-admin routes.

checks.invariant: Issued JWTs are HS256-signed, alg-pinned, expiring, and bound to DB user+account; foreign aud/iss tokens are rejected.
checks.result: create_access_token sets sub, account_id, role, iat, exp (default 43200 minutes). user_from_access_token decodes with secret_key, algorithms=[HS256], require_sub, verify_aud False, then loads User by sub+account_id and rejects inactive accounts. Role for authorization is the DB row, not the JWT role claim. No iss/aud/purpose/jti. No jwt.decode without verify. OAuth state JWTs lack sub so they cannot pass require_sub. Weak SECRET_KEY is rejected only when ENVIRONMENT is production.

checks.invariant: Password change, team reset, and logout invalidate outstanding access JWTs.
checks.result: User has no token_version/jti. PATCH /auth/password and POST /team/members/{id}/reset-password update password_hash only. There is no logout or denylist. Pre-change JWTs still verify until exp (up to 90 days). Account.is_active false is enforced at verification. There is no unauthenticated email password-reset token flow.

checks.invariant: Login requires bcrypt of the stored hash and does not mint tokens for inactive accounts.
checks.result: POST /auth/login looks up email, verify_password (bcrypt, 72-byte cap, fail closed on errors), then Account.is_active, then create_access_token. Invalid login is a uniform 401. No rate limit.

checks.invariant: Real .env, keys, and local databases are not git-tracked.
checks.result: .gitignore ignores .env, .env.local, frontend/mobile env local files, *.pem *.key *.p12, *.db, backend/data, and venv. git check-ignore matches backend/.env, mobile/.env, .env, and frontend/.env.local. git ls-files has no .env, pem, key, or db files.

checks.invariant: Tracked env templates contain placeholders only, not live credentials.
checks.result: backend/.env.example uses dummy SECRET_KEY=change-me and empty GOOGLE_API_KEY, META_APP_SECRET, SMTP_PASSWORD, R2, and related secret fields. mobile/.env.example has only a placeholder EXPO_PUBLIC_API_BASE URL. No AIza/AKIA/ghp_/BEGIN PRIVATE material in tracked templates.

checks.invariant: Git history does not retain a real committed secret file.
checks.result: git log --all --full-history on .env, pem, key, p12, credentials.json, and app.db shows only backend/.env.example and mobile/.env.example. git log -S for AIza, AKIA, BEGIN PRIVATE, and ghp_ returned no commits. No live secret value is cited.

checks.invariant: Docker build context excludes secret env files so images do not bake live credentials.
checks.result: .dockerignore excludes .env and backend/.env. Dockerfile.api and Dockerfile.worker COPY backend/. Dockerfile.web COPY frontend/ is not covered by a frontend/.env.local ignore. No tracked secret file is in the context; leftover local untracked env at build time is not source-proven.

candidates.title: Staff JWT placed in EventSource and upload query strings
candidates.description: A lower-trust observer of API/proxy access logs or the HTTP request target can recover a staff JWT. The dashboard EventSource URL includes access_token= the live token. The same Query parameter authenticates SSE and catalog upload routes. Tokens last up to 30 days by default and are not revoked on password change.
candidates.claimed_root_cause: get_current_user_sse accepts Query access_token as equivalent to Authorization Bearer, and the dashboard EventSource puts that JWT in the URL. Default uvicorn process logging records the request query.

trace.description: Browser builds /jobs/{id}/events?access_token= plus the staff JWT and opens EventSource on it.
FastAPI Query access_token is documented as the EventSource JWT and is optional beside HTTP Bearer.
Query value is OR'd with Bearer credentials and passed to user_from_access_token, minting a full User principal for SSE and for POST /jobs/upload and /jobs/{id}/upload-files.

evidence.description: EventSource URL concatenates encodeURIComponent(token) into query access_token.
token = Bearer credentials or stripped access_token query; empty raises 401.
job_events_sse Depends(get_current_user_sse) and documents query access_token.
create_job_from_upload Depends(get_current_user_sse), so query JWT also authorizes multipart catalog upload.
Production API is uvicorn app.main:app without --no-access-log.
Container CMD also launches uvicorn without disabling access logs.

candidates.title: Unauthenticated /health discloses catalog upload root and disk inventory
candidates.description: An anonymous caller of GET /health receives the absolute catalog upload filesystem path, a count of catalog images on disk, whether R2 is configured, and Gemini model names. That is more than a liveness probe and maps internal layout used by catalog storage. The handler also walks the upload tree (capped at 200000 files) with no auth.
candidates.claimed_root_cause: health() is unauthenticated and serializes upload_root() and _count_catalog_image_files() into HealthResponse, unlike production path redaction used for job input_folder.

trace.description: Anonymous health route with no Depends authentication.
upload_root() resolves backend/data/uploads to an absolute Path.
Handler returns catalog_upload_root=str(root), image file count, r2 flag, and model names to the anonymous client.

evidence.description: @app.get("/health") has no current-user dependency.
catalog_upload_root is the raw absolute path string, not public_job_input_folder.
catalog_image_files_on_disk calls _count_catalog_image_files() on every anonymous request.
HealthResponse includes catalog_upload_root, catalog_image_files_on_disk, and catalog_r2_configured.
public_job_input_folder redacts absolute paths in production for jobs only; health does not call it.

candidates.title: Default FastAPI /docs /redoc /openapi.json left enabled
candidates.description: Anonymous callers can load Swagger and the OpenAPI document for the full authenticated API, including admin, CT Seller, Facebook, catalog upload, and the access_token query parameter. No production gate disables docs.
candidates.claimed_root_cause: FastAPI() is constructed with defaults only; docs_url/redoc_url/openapi_url are never set to None.

Unset docs_url/redoc_url/openapi_url means FastAPI serves /docs, /redoc, and /openapi.json to unauthenticated clients.

evidence.description: FastAPI app created without disabling OpenAPI UI or schema.
OpenAPI will advertise Query access_token on SSE/upload auth because it is a documented Query parameter.
fastapi>=0.115.0 still enables /docs by default when docs_url is omitted.

candidates.title: Open registration defaults on and mints owner JWTs
candidates.description: POST /auth/register is public. The production close-gate requires both ENVIRONMENT=production and ALLOW_OPEN_REGISTRATION=false. The setting defaults true, .env.example leaves it true, and DEPLOY.md treats closing signup as a post-bootstrap step. A successful call creates an owner tenant and returns an access JWT. The web UI always exposes Register.
candidates.claimed_root_cause: allow_open_registration defaults True and register only 403s when is_production and that flag is false, so a production deploy that omits the flag keeps anonymous owner-JWT minting.

trace.description: allow_open_registration Field default True; production_must_be_safe does not require it false.
After creating Account, owner User, and General sale, register returns create_access_token for that owner.

evidence.description: 403 only if is_production and not allow_open_registration.
ALLOW_OPEN_REGISTRATION defaults True with comment to set true only to bootstrap.
Example env sets ALLOW_OPEN_REGISTRATION=true.
Deploy table says default true and to set false after the first real account.
Public login page posts /auth/register when mode is register.
create_access_token signs sub/account_id/role with HS256 and long default TTL.

candidates.title: Register can claim MASTER_ADMIN_EMAILS before the operator user exists
candidates.description: Master admin is not a DB role. Any authenticated User whose email is in MASTER_ADMIN_EMAILS passes _require_master_admin and can list/update all accounts. register does not reserve those emails, so during open registration an anonymous caller who knows an allowlisted address and registers it first becomes master admin.
candidates.claimed_root_cause: is_master_admin_email is only an env email allowlist on the current user; register never rejects or pre-binds MASTER_ADMIN_EMAILS.

trace.description: New User is stored with payload.email and role owner with no master-admin reservation.
Admin check is membership of stripped lowercased email in settings.master_admin_email_list().
Admin routes such as GET /admin/accounts authorize solely by that email match on the JWT-backed User.

evidence.description: register creates User(email=payload.email.lower(), role=owner) with no MASTER_ADMIN_EMAILS check.
is_master_admin_email compares email to the env allowlist only.
GET /admin/accounts is get_current_user plus _require_master_admin with no extra secret.
master_admin_emails defaults empty; when set, source does not create or lock those users.

candidates.title: Password change and team reset do not invalidate access JWTs
candidates.description: Access tokens are stateless HS256 JWTs with no jti or server denylist. PATCH /auth/password and owner team-member reset update password_hash only. There is no logout. A stolen token remains valid until exp (default 30 days, max 90) after the password is changed. Account disable is checked at verification; password change is not.
candidates.claimed_root_cause: User has no token_version; password-change and reset paths never rotate or revoke outstanding JWTs, and user_from_access_token only checks signature, exp, user row, and Account.is_active.

trace.description: Authenticated password change rewrites password_hash and commits with no token revocation.
User columns have no token_version, jti list, or password_changed_at used at verify time.
Pre-change JWTs still decode and load the same User until exp as long as the account is active.

evidence.description: change_own_password sets password_hash and db.commit only.
reset_team_member_password also only hashes the new password.
Verification loads User by id+account_id; no password-epoch or denylist check.
Default ACCESS_TOKEN_EXPIRE_MINUTES is 43200 (30 days), max 129600.

blockers: OS-enforced sandbox and parent artifact promotion unavailable

validation_plan.local: In the OS sandbox, register a dummy user, save JWT A, PATCH /auth/password, then call GET /auth/me with JWT A and expect the intended 401 if revocation were implemented (source predicts 200).
validation_plan.deployment: Owner confirms production has no extra API gateway JWT denylist; do not test with live staff tokens.

hardening: JWT verification pins algorithms=[HS256], require_sub, and binds sub+account_id to the User row; inactive accounts are 403. OAuth state JWTs lack sub and require purpose=meta_oauth, so they are not usable as access tokens.
Authorization uses DB User.role, not the JWT role claim, so role changes do not wait for expiry.
No unauthenticated email password-reset token flow; team reset is owner-authenticated. bcrypt uses gensalt(rounds=12) and rejects >72-byte passwords.
production_must_be_safe rejects documented weak SECRET_KEY values, SQLite, and empty CORS_ORIGINS when ENVIRONMENT is production.
Login returns a uniform Invalid login 401 (register still enumerates existing emails with 400 Email already exists). No login rate limit is present.
JWTs have no aud/iss/purpose claim; acceptable only while SECRET_KEY is unique to this API.
TRUSTED_HOSTS empty disables TrustedHostMiddleware; Host is not used for JWT or register identity.

Tracked env templates and git history did not contain a live secret. .dockerignore ignores .env and backend/.env but not frontend/.env.local; Dockerfile.web COPY frontend/ could bake an untracked local env if present at image build.
